The '''strong nuclear interaction''' is one of the four [[fundamental interactions]] between [[quantum particle]]s.

== Properties ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
| Carrier particle
| $g$ [[gluon]]
|-
| Participants
| [[quark]]s
|-
| Effective range
| $10^{-15} \mathrm{m}$
|}

<ref>{{#cite:Q2545}}</ref>

== Example interactions ==

=== proton-neutron strong nuclear interaction ===

[[File:Feynman diagram proton-neutron strong nuclear interaction.jpg|400px|center]]

As seen in the [[Feynman diagram]], the proton converts into a neutron and the neutron converts into a proton during the interaction.

<ref>{{#cite:Q2545}}</ref>
